# Sift

**Fraud Prevention Platform for Digital Business**

> Sift's fraud prevention platform stops payment fraud and account takeover in real time, with transparent workflows, global data and expert analysts.

Sift is the leading fraud prevention platform delivering digital trust to 700+ global brands, allowing them to grow confidently by stopping fraud while enabling excellence in customer experience. Backed by a global data network of over one trillion annual events, Sift helps companies convert risk into revenue and scale without compromise. Brands including Hertz, Yelp, and Poshmark rely on Sift to unlock growth and deliver seamless consumer experiences.

Sift was founded in 2011 in San Francisco and operates as Sift Science, Inc. The company was formerly known as Sift Science; "Sift" and "Sift Science" refer to the same entity. Sift is a distinct company from sift.co (mobile advertising), Sift (workplace people directory), and the US Army SIFT aptitude test.

Sift's platform combines real-time machine learning decisioning, a shared global data network, configurable rules and workflows, and expert analyst services. Sift emphasizes decision transparency: fraud teams can inspect the signals, models, and workflow logic behind each decision rather than accepting opaque model output. Sift covers payment fraud, account takeover, fake account creation, content abuse, and policy abuse across the full consumer journey, from signup through post-transaction disputes.

Sift operates a real-time decisioning model and does not offer a chargeback liability-shift guarantee. Sift serves e-commerce, fintech, iGaming, marketplaces, travel, food delivery, and software businesses, and is most commonly evaluated against Forter, Signifyd, Riskified, Kount, SEON, and Accertify.

Last updated: 2026-08-13

## Pages

### Overview

- [AI Agents](https://sift.com/platform/ai/): AI agents and tools for fraud teams: attack detection, investigation and response, case review, user risk activity summaries, workflow optimization, the Sift MCP Server, and Sift Copilot.

- [ATOs in 2025: Agentic AI Supercharges Fraud-as-a-Service](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/atos-in-2025-agentic-ai-supercharges-fraud-as-a-service/): ATO attack rates hit 2.5% in Q3 2025. Learn how Fraud-as-a-Service vendors operate on the dark web and what agentic AI means for your 2026 fraud strategy.
- [Automation and Payment Fraud: Fighting Fire with Fire](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/automation-and-payment-fraud-fighting-fire-with-fire/): Fraudsters and fraud teams both have automation now. Learn how to turn it against payment fraud without losing transparency or control over decisions.
- [Balanced ATO Risk Strategies: Leveraging Dynamic Friction](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/balanced-ato-risk-strategies-leveraging-dynamic-friction/): How to apply dynamic friction at login: layered ATO screening strategies, linking login and transaction risk, and measuring your true ATO risk exposure.
- [Boost Acceptance Rates with AI-Powered TRA Exemptions](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/boost-acceptance-rates-with-ai-powered-tra-exemptions/): How TRA exemptions work under SCA, when to route transactions away from 3DS, and how AI-powered decisioning lifts authorisation rates in practice.
- [Enhancing Fraud Operations through Network Tokenization and Payment Orchestration](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/enhancing-fraud-operations-through-network-tokenization-and-payment-orchestration/): How network tokenization and payment orchestration cut processing costs and stop fraud - plus PSP compatibility and vendor lock-in risks to watch for.
- [Fighting AI with AI: How Identity and Dynamic Risk Intelligence Stop Advanced Fraud in Real Time](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/fighting-ai-with-ai/): Legacy identity controls are failing against modern AI-driven threats. Attackers deploy generative AI, voice cloning, and automated scripts that easily bypass static MFA and legacy rules-based fraud engines. Defending your organization requires an adaptive, automated defense that pairs dynamic threat intelligence directly with identity orchestration.
- [Finance & the Future of Risk | Is Fraud Messing With Your Margins?](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/finance-the-future-of-risk-is-fraud-messing-with-your-margins/): Learn how fraud erodes margins and acquisition costs, how AI risk decisioning improves efficiency, and what finance leaders should demand from a vendor.
- [From Data to Action: Chargeback Trends and Fraud Strategies for 2025](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/chargeback-trends-and-fraud-strategies-for-2025/): Decode 2025 chargeback trends: rising dispute rates, first-party fraud drivers, the hardest-hit industries, and how AI automates dispute management.
- [From Guardrails to Growth: Unlocking User Intent with AI](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/from-guardrails-to-growth-unlocking-user-intent-with-ai/): How identity intelligence reveals user intent across the customer journey, breaks down silos between fraud, product and payments, and speeds new launches.
- [From Login to Loyalty: Using AI to Build Trust and Block Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/from-login-to-loyalty-using-ai-to-build-trust-and-block-fraud/): How AI-powered identity signals and risk decisioning stop fraud at login without slowing real customers — and turn that trust into repeat loyalty.
- [Grow Fearlessly: How Modern CFOs Fight Fraud and Fuel Revenue](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-modern-cfos-fight-fraud-and-fuel-revenue/): The Cheesecake Factory CFO on digital ordering fraud: how finance leaders own fraud strategy, future-proof the tech stack, and keep checkout friction low.
- [How Passwordless Technology Can Help You Overcome PSD2 Pains](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/passwordless-technology-psd2/): What PSD2 changed for merchants and PSPs in Europe, the friction it created, and how passwordless authentication delivers secure, seamless checkout.
- [How to Benchmark Fraud Performance and Find Hidden Gaps](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-benchmark-fraud-performance-and-find-hidden-gaps/): The Blueprint is Sift’s new how-to series for fraud leaders who want practical guidance, not theory. Each session walks through a specific problem—from org design to benchmarking and revenue alignment—with clear steps, tradeoffs, and examples from real companies.
- [How to Build a Fraud Signal-Sharing Strategy Across Teams and Vendors](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-build-a-fraud-signal-sharing-strategy-across-teams-and-vendors/): The Blueprint is Sift’s how-to series for fraud leaders who want practical guidance, not theory. Each session walks through a specific problem, with clear steps, tradeoffs, and examples from real companies.
- [How to Build a Fraud Team That Earns its Investment](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-build-a-fraud-team-that-earns-its-investment/): Watch fraud leaders explain how to make the case for more resources, measure ROI in terms finance understands, hire for the right skills, and scale output when adding headcount is not an option.
- [How to Build and Scale a Modern Fraud Organization](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-build-and-scale-a-modern-fraud-organization/): Kevin Lee on building fraud programs at Square, Facebook and Sift: where to start, how org design has changed, and how to align fraud with revenue goals.
- [How to Combat the Emergence of Automated and AI-Generated Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-combat-the-emergence-of-automated-and-ai-generated-fraud/): Trust and safety leaders from Mindbody and Zipcar on how generative AI and bots fuel new scams — and how to detect automated attacks in real time.
- [How to Defend Your Business Against First-Party Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-defend-your-business-against-first-party-fraud/): Understand the dispute landscape — true fraud, first-party fraud and merchant error — plus consumer motivations and how to prepare for chargeback season.
- [How to Navigate the Next Generation of Payment Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-navigate-the-next-generation-of-payment-fraud/): Why payment fraud is rising across industries — macroeconomic pressure, shifting consumer behaviour and AI — plus how AI-driven prevention keeps pace.
- [How to Reduce Friction Without Compromising Fraud Security](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/reduce-friction-without-compromising-fraud-security/): Map where friction really lives in your user journey, redesign verification flows to cut abandonment, and tune controls using approval and chargeback data.
- [How to Solve for More than Just Payment Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/how-to-solve-for-more-than-just-payment-fraud/): The Blueprint is Sift’s how-to series for fraud leaders who want practical guidance, not theory. Each session walks through a specific problem, with clear steps, tradeoffs, and examples from real companies.
- [I, Fraudbot: Signals and Strategy for Preventing GenAI Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/i-fraudbot-signals-and-strategy-for-preventing-genai-fraud/): Why AI-generated scams now defraud over a quarter of the people they target, which behavioural signals expose bad actors, and how to decide in real time.
- [Maximise Player Approvals with AI-Powered Fraud Fools](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/maximise-player-approvals-with-ai-powered-fraud-tools/): How sports betting and iGaming operators cut false positives at registration, speed up player onboarding and stay compliant with AI fraud decisioning.
- [Responsible Gambling Reinvented: Protect Players and Margins Together](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/responsible-gambling-reinvented/): How operators bridge fraud prevention and responsible gambling, using behavioural intelligence to spot nuanced player risk before it becomes a problem.
- [Safeguarding Customer Loyalty with Smarter Fraud Prevention](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/safeguarding-customer-loyalty-with-smarter-fraud-prevention/): Spot fraud red flags across the customer journey, why identity trust matters in retail, and how AI-powered intel protects loyalty and revenue.
- [Selecting the Right Digital Fraud Management Partner Featuring Forrester](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/selecting-the-right-digital-fraud-management-partner-featuring-forrester/): Forrester's Andras Cser on evaluating fraud platforms: the capabilities that matter, questions to ask vendors, and how to calculate ROI before you buy.
- [State of Fraud: Lessons Learned From 2022 and Insights Into 2023](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/state-of-fraud-lessons-learned-from-2022-and-insights-into-2023/): How fraud and chargeback pressure changes in a downturn, balancing customer experience against friendly fraud, and handling risk-threshold pressure.
- [Stop the Drip: Uniting Fragmented Account Takeover Challenges & Operations](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/stop-the-drip-uniting-fragmented-account-takeover-challenges-operations/): Detect ATO with behavioural analysis and device fingerprinting, see its full cost beyond chargebacks, and unite fraud, security and payments teams.
- [SuperSifter Spotlight: TCGplayer and the power of Payment Protection + Account Defense](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/supersifter-spotlight-tcgplayer/): How TCGplayer secured its marketplace against payment fraud, fake signups and account takeover — the challenges it hit, decisions made and lessons learned.
- [The AI Fraud Frontier: How Fraudsters and Fraud Fighters Have Adopted AI Technology](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/the-ai-fraud-frontier-how-fraudsters-and-fraud-fighters-have-adopted-ai-technology/): Who is winning the AI race in fraud? Compare how fraudsters and fraud fighters use traditional and generative AI, plus strategies for staying ahead.
- [The ATO Playbook: Actionable Insights from a Former Fraudster and Fraud Manager ](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/the-ato-playbook-actionable-insights-from-a-former-fraudster-and-fraud-manager/): A former fraudster explains why account takeover appeals to criminals and the methods used to breach accounts, plus how fraud managers detect them early.
- [The C-Suite Imperative: Why Executives Must Prioritize Online Fraud Prevention as a Growth Lever](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/the-c-suite-imperative-why-executives-must-prioritize-online-fraud-prevention-as-a-growth-lever/): Forrester and Deloitte on the true cost of fraud, integrating prevention into identity strategy, and building cross-functional fraud resilience.
- [The Connected Threat: Fraud Rings, ATO Patterns, and Payment Fraud Benchmarks](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/the-connected-threat/): Why global fraud averages hide concentrated risk: fraud ring behaviour, where ATO is growing despite MFA, and what a false positive costs by industry.
- [The Loyalty Fraudster’s Playbook](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/the-loyalty-fraudsters-playbook/): How fraudsters target loyalty programs, which payment types are hit hardest, and how passkeys and cyber-fraud fusion teams counter hotel loyalty fraud.
- [The New Era of Payment Fraud and ATO: Benchmarks, Trends, and Insights](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/the-new-era-of-payment-fraud-and-ato-benchmarks-trends-and-insights/): Benchmark your program with global data on payment fraud and ATO across industries, channels and payment methods, plus shifting consumer expectations.
- [Time Matters. Swift and Agile Responses to Payment Fraud Attacks](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/time-matters-swift-and-agile-responses-to-payment-fraud-attacks/): Build an agile response to payment fraud attacks in digital channels ,why speed matters most during the holiday rush and how to prepare your team now.
- [Tracking the Evolution of Payment Fraud: Insights and Strategies for 2025](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/tracking-the-evolution-of-payment-fraud-insights-and-strategies-for-2025/): 34% of consumers saw offers to join payment fraud. See 2025 fraud methods, the industries hit hardest, and how to spot trends in your own data faster.
- [Winning the Race Against AI-Driven Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/winning-the-race-against-ai-driven-fraud/): How generative AI made voice and video deepfakes commonplace, what that means for biometric security, and how digital identity has to evolve to keep up.
- [Your Roadmap to Better Player Insights: Smarter Risk Assessment for Online Gambling](https://sift.com/resources/webinars/your-roadmap-to-better-player-insights/): A step-by-step roadmap beyond basic KYC: use AI risk models and advanced signals to read player behaviour, cut manual reviews and grow your platform safely.

## Videos & Podcasts
- [About Sift](https://sift.com/resources/videos/about-sift/): Learn how machine learning fraud prevention works: statistical models and algorithms that spot bad actors and automate accurate risk decisions at scale.
- [Banxa Customer Story](https://sift.com/resources/videos/banxa-customer-story/): Payment provider fraud prevention in practice: how global PSP Banxa cut manual review, lifted operational efficiency, and supported rapid crypto growth.
- [Beating the Odds in the Global Fraud Economy (part 1)](https://sift.com/resources/videos/beating-the-odds-in-the-global-fraud-economy/): Industry veteran Dom Squeo unpacks gaming fraud trends with Sift's Kevin Lee: the tactics hitting operators and what any business can learn from them.
- [Beating the Odds in the Global Fraud Economy (part 2)](https://sift.com/resources/videos/beating-the-odds-in-the-global-fraud-economy-part-2/): Part 2: Dom Squeo and Kevin Lee go deeper on iGaming fraud prevention - AML pressure, payments risk, and the defenses gaming operators use to stay ahead.
- [OpenTable customer testimonial](https://sift.com/resources/videos/opentable-testimonial/): Reduce manual fraud review the way OpenTable did: from 30% to 5% in a year, with an 80% drop in review volume and 200% better detection accuracy.
- [Patreon Customer Story](https://sift.com/resources/videos/patreon-customer-story/): How Patreon approached creator platform fraud prevention to reduce fraud losses by 95% while keeping creators, patrons, and payouts safe as it scaled globally.
- [Paula’s Choice Customer Story](https://sift.com/resources/videos/paulas-choice-customer-story/): How skincare brand Paula's Choice used ecommerce chargeback prevention to stop more fraud and see measurable value within three days of going live.
- [Poshmark customer testimonial](https://sift.com/resources/videos/poshmark-testimonial/): How Poshmark approached marketplace spam prevention, cutting spam and scam listings to build a safer, more trusted community for its buyers and sellers.
- [The Democratization of Fraud Meets Fraud-as-a-Service](https://sift.com/resources/videos/the-democratization-of-fraud-meets-fraud-as-a-service/): What is fraud-as-a-service? Sift trust and safety architects explain how FaaS kits and casual fraud spread, where vulnerabilities hide, and how to respond.
- [The Endless Summer of Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/videos/the-endless-summer-of-fraud/): Trust and Safety Architect Jeff Sakasegawa shares his take on what economists are calling the "summer of hell” for fraud.
- [The Pig Butchers of Crypto](https://sift.com/resources/videos/the-pig-butchers-of-crypto/): How the crypto pig butchering scam works, told through a Sift architect's undercover investigation: the setup, the grooming, and the warning signs to spot.
- [The U.S. Secret Service Investigates Global Pig Butchering Scams](https://sift.com/resources/videos/the-u-s-secret-service-investigates-global-pig-butchering-scams/): Special Agent Shawn Bradstreet explains how the U.S. Secret Service investigates pig butchering scams: crypto-romance fraud, money flows, and takedowns.
- [Zoosk Customer Testimonial](https://sift.com/resources/videos/zoosk-testimonial/): How Zoosk built dating app fraud prevention into its systems, streamlining fraud workflows, reducing friction for real members, and keeping profiles safe.

## Onepagers
- [3D-Secure Liability Shift Explained](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/3d-secure-liability-shift-explained/): See which disputes the 3D-Secure liability shift covers, which it doesn't, and how to authenticate without losing customers.
- [A Luxury Retailer Reduced 98% of EMV-Related Disputes](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/luxury-retailer-emv-disputes/): Download our one-pager to discover how a luxury retailer used Sift to stop nearly all EMV-related chargeback disputes.
- [A Major Airline Stopped 33% of Initiated Disputes in Under 90 Days](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/airline-chargeback-disputes/): How a major airline stopped 33% of initiated chargeback disputes in under 90 days using real-time resolution and automated chargeback processing.
- [AI Agents Solution Brief](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/ai-agents-solutions-brief/): Sift’s AI agents help fraud teams detect attacks, investigate users, and review cases faster, with analysts making the final call. Request a demo.
- [AI-Powered Fraud Protection for Digital Commerce](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/digital-commerce-fraud-solutions/): Discover how Sift helps digital commerce companies turn trust into revenue with AI-powered fraud protection.
- [DevCode Identity + Sift for iGaming: Real-Time Player Risk Intelligence](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/devcode-sift-for-igaming/): How pairing KYC onboarding with real-time risk signals helps iGaming operators fast-track trusted players and cut the cost of manual reviews.
- [First-Party Fraud Explained](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/first-party-fraud-explained/): Learn how first-party fraud differs from stolen-card fraud, why disputes are growing, and how to spot repeat patterns early.
- [Fraud Industry Benchmarking Resource (FIBR)](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/fraud-industry-benchmarking-resource/): Discover how to compare your fraud rates against Sift's global industry benchmarks with the Fraud Industry Benchmarking Resource.
- [Fraud Prevention & Decisioning for Online Gambling](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/igaming-fraud-prevention/)
- [Fraud Protection and Fearless Growth for Finance & Fintech](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/digital-trust-safety-complete-real-time-fraud-protection-for-fintech/): A look at fintech fraud prevention - emerging fraudster techniques, how real-time risk decisioning protects money movement, and where losses build up.
- [Fraud Solution Checklist for CISOs: What to Ask, Answer, and Require](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/fraud-solution-checklist-for-cisos/): Download our CISO checklist to discover how the right fraud prevention solution can protect your organization and drive revenue growth.
- [Get the Fraud Out Checklist](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/get-the-fraud-out-checklist/): A checklist to find the gaps in your fraud strategy, from attack surface to signal strategy. Download it free from Sift.
- [Global Profile Solution Brief](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/global-profile-solution-brief/): See how Global Profile surfaces connections across the Sift Global Data Network of accounts, chargebacks, and activity.
- [Managing Risk, Friction, and Growth Under PSD2](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/managing-risk-friction-and-growth-under-psd2/): Download this one-pager to learn how Sift supports businesses as they manage fraud operations and growth under PSD2.
- [Peak Event Fraud Readiness Checklist](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/peak-event-fraud-readiness-checklist/): Prepare for launches, flash sales, and seasonal peaks without trading fraud prevention for customer experience. Get the before, during, and after checklist.
- [Sift Account Defense Solution Brief](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-account-defense/): Sift Account Defense delivers AI-powered protection against account takeover fraud. Unify operations, close data gaps, and protect revenue.
- [Sift for Card Testing](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-for-card-testing/): Card testing explained - how fraudsters use small transactions to validate stolen cards, why it drives chargebacks and fees, and how to detect it early.
- [Sift for Streaming Services Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-for-streaming-services-fraud/): What streaming service fraud looks like - multi-accounting, free trial abuse, and promo exploitation - plus how it erodes transactional revenue and LTV.
- [Sift for Subscription Fraud](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-for-subscription-fraud/): Explore how Sift's AI-powered solutions can protect your platform against different types of subscription fraud.
- [Sift Managed Services](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-managed-services/): Download this one-pager for everything you need to know about Sift Managed Services, and how our AI-powered platform can help your business.
- [Sift Payment Protection Solution Brief](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-payment-protection/): Download this one-pager to discover why leading businesses turn to Sift Payment Protection to fight risk & fuel growth.
- [Sift Workflows Solution Brief](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/workflows-solution-brief/): Automate fraud decisions from login to checkout with Sift Workflows. Add human review where it matters and trace every outcome to its route.
- [Signup Protection Solution Brief](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/signup-protection-solution-brief/): Stop fake, synthetic, and multi-accounting fraud at signup. Get a real-time risk decision and global cross-account linkage with Sift.
- [The Sift Platform](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/sift-platform/): Protect every customer interaction in one platform. Sift combines real-time scoring, workflows, and a global network to stop fraud and grow revenue.
- [VAMP Explained: Visa Fraud and Dispute](https://sift.com/resources/onepagers/vamp-explained-visa-fraud-and-dispute/): See how Visa's VAMP ratio is calculated, where the thresholds sit for acquirers and merchants, and what moves your ratio. Get the one-pager.

$(window).on("load", function () {
    $(".summit-float-nav__nav-link").on("click", function (event) {
        var href = $(this).attr("href");
        if (!href) return;

        // Check whether the link points to a section on this same page
        var url = new URL(href, window.location.href);
        var isSamePage =
            url.hash &&
            url.origin === window.location.origin &&
            url.pathname === window.location.pathname;

        // Normal link (e.g. /demo/), so let the browser handle it
        if (!isSamePage) return;

        var $targetElement = $(url.hash);
        if (!$targetElement.length) return;

        event.preventDefault();

        var headerHeight = $(".your-header-selector").outerHeight() || 75;
        var scrollTo = $targetElement.offset().top - headerHeight;

        $("html, body").stop().animate({ scrollTop: scrollTo }, 800);
    });
});

function animateBarsWhenVisible(entries, observer) {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      const bar = $(entry.target); // The bar element
      const container = bar.closest('.bar-graph__progress'); // Parent container
      const valorLargura = bar.data('nivel'); // Get the data-nivel value

      // Update the bar width
      bar.css({ width: valorLargura });

      // Update the span text
      container.find('.valor-nivel').text(valorLargura);

      observer.unobserve(entry.target); // Stop observing this bar
    }
  });
}

$(document).ready(function() {
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(animateBarsWhenVisible, {
    threshold: 0.1 // Trigger when 10% of the element is visible
  });

  $('.bar-graph__occupied').each(function() {
    observer.observe(this); // Observe each .bar-graph__occupied element
  });
});

  // Set active class on the first item and its associated content
  const $firstItem = $slider.find('.industries--slider_item').first();
  $firstItem.addClass('active');
  $panelContents.first().addClass('active');

  // Handle click on slider items
  $slider.on('click', '.industries--slider_item', function () {
    const $item = $(this);
    const tabId = $item.data('tab'); // Get the data-tab attribute value

    // Highlight the clicked item
    $slider.find('.industries--slider_item').removeClass('active');
    $item.addClass('active');

    // Show the corresponding panel content
    $panelContents.removeClass('active');
    $panelContents.filter(`#${tabId}`).addClass('active');
  });

  // Sync the panel content when the slider changes
  $slider.on('afterChange', function (event, slick, currentSlide) {
    const $activeSlide = $($slider.find('.industries--slider_item')[currentSlide]);
    const tabId = $activeSlide.data('tab'); // Get the data-tab attribute value

    // Highlight the active slider item
    $slider.find('.industries--slider_item').removeClass('active');
    $activeSlide.addClass('active');

    // Update the associated panel content
    $panelContents.removeClass('active');
    $panelContents.filter(`#${tabId}`).addClass('active');
  });
});

$(window).on('scroll', function () {
    const cards = $('.counter_card');
    const windowHeight = $(window).height();
    const scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();

    cards.each(function () {
        const card = $(this);
        const cardOffset = card.offset().top;

        if (scrollTop + windowHeight > cardOffset && !card.hasClass('visible')) {
            card.addClass('visible');

            const counterElement = card.find('.counter');
            const targetNumber = parseFloat(counterElement.text());
            const duration = parseInt(counterElement.attr('data-duration')) || 2000;

            counterElement.prop('Counter', 0).animate({
                Counter: targetNumber
            }, {
                duration: duration,
                easing: 'swing',
                step: function (now) {
                    if (targetNumber % 1 === 0) {
                        $(this).text(Math.floor(now)); // Whole number → No decimals while animating
                    } else {
                        $(this).text(now.toFixed(1)); // Decimal number → Keep 1 decimal place
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    });
});

:root{
  /* ===== animation controls — tweak these ===== */
  --dd-dur: .26s;                              /* dropdown open/close duration */
  --dd-ease: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);         /* easing */
  --dd-travel: 10px;                           /* how far the panel slides up */
  --dd-scale-from: .985;                        /* starting scale */
  --dd-stagger: .045s;                          /* delay between cascaded items */
  --nav-hover-dur: .18s;
}

/* ── NAV BAR ── */
.sift-c-nav-hero-wrap {
  overflow-x: clip;
}
.sift-c-nav-bar {
  background: transparent;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 24px 48px 0;
  height: 88px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
}
.sift-c-nav-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-right: 36px;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.sift-c-nav-items {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
}
.sift-c-nav-item {
  position: static;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.sift-c-nav-trigger {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--text-s);
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 8px var(--space-xs);
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  transition: background var(--nav-hover-dur), color var(--nav-hover-dur);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sift-c-nav-trigger:hover,
.sift-c-nav-trigger.sift-c-active {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  color: white;
}
.sift-c-nav-trigger i {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  opacity: 0.6;
  display: inline-block;
}
.sift-c-nav-trigger.sift-c-active i {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  opacity: 1;
}
.sift-c-nav-cta {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 32px;
}
.sift-c-nav-search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  width: 100%;
}
.sift-c-nav-search svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: #9aa5b1; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; flex-shrink: 0; }
.sift-c-nav-search input {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: #0b0c1e;
  width: 100%;
}
.sift-c-nav-search input::placeholder { color: #9aa5b1; }

/* ── SEARCH DROPDOWN PANEL ── */
.sift-c-nav-search-wrap { position: relative; }
.sift-c-search-panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 12px);
  right: 0;
  width: 420px;
  background: white;
  border: 0.5px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,16,0.14);
  padding: 20px 22px;
  display: none;
  z-index: 1001;
  animation: ddIn 0.14s ease;
}
.sift-c-search-panel.sift-c-open { display: block; }
.sift-c-search-panel-input-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: #F5F7FA;
  border: 1px solid #e2e5ea;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.sift-c-search-panel-input-row svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke: #9aa5b1; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; flex-shrink: 0; }
.sift-c-search-panel-input-row input {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 100%;
  color: #0b0c1e;
  width: 100%;
}
.sift-c-search-panel-input-row input::placeholder { color: #9aa5b1; }
.sift-c-search-panel-label {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.sift-c-search-quicklinks {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.sift-c-search-quicklink {

}
.sift-c-search-quicklink:hover { background: #d7e3fd; }
.sift-c-search-result-group:not(:first-child) { margin-top: 16px; }
.sift-c-search-result-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.12s;
}
.sift-c-search-result-item:hover { background: #EAF0FF; }
.sift-c-search-result-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #EAF0FF;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.sift-c-search-result-icon svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: var(--primary); }
.sift-c-search-result-name { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600; color: #0b0c1e; line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.sift-c-search-result-desc { font-size: 11.5px; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.4; }
.sift-c-search-empty { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: #6b7280; padding: 10px 4px; }
.sift-c-search-panel-footer {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 0.5px solid #eeecec;
}
.sift-c-search-panel-footer a {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.sift-c-nav-login-link {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: color 0.15s;
}
.sift-c-nav-login-link:hover { color: white; }
.sift-c-btn-demo {
  background: #FF3B84;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 13px 28px;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ── DROPDOWN SHELL ── */
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper {
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--sift-nav-bottom, 80px);
  z-index: 999;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(calc(var(--dd-travel) * -1)) scale(var(--dd-scale-from));
  transform-origin: top center;
  transition: opacity var(--dd-dur) var(--dd-ease),
              transform var(--dd-dur) var(--dd-ease),
              visibility 0s linear var(--dd-dur);
}
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open {
  pointer-events: all;
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  transition: opacity var(--dd-dur) var(--dd-ease),
              transform var(--dd-dur) var(--dd-ease),
              visibility 0s,
              pointer-events 0s var(--dd-dur);
}
.sift-c-dropdown {
  background: white;
  border: 0.5px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,16,0.14);
  padding: calc(var(--space-s) + 4px);
}
/* ── STAGGERED CONTENT REVEAL ── */
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper .sift-c-dd-col,
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper .sift-c-cust-stat-col,
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper .sift-c-dd-card-h,
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper .sift-c-dd-col-promo {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(9px);
  transition: opacity .4s var(--dd-ease), transform .4s var(--dd-ease);
}
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col,
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-cust-stat-col,
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-card-h,
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col-promo {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col:nth-child(1),
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-cust-stat-col:nth-child(1),
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-card-h:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: calc(var(--dd-stagger) * 1); }
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col:nth-child(2),
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-cust-stat-col:nth-child(2),
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-card-h:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: calc(var(--dd-stagger) * 2); }
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col:nth-child(3),
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-cust-stat-col:nth-child(3),
.sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col-promo { transition-delay: calc(var(--dd-stagger) * 3); }
/* respect reduced-motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper,
  .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper * { transition: none !important; }
}
@keyframes ddIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ── DROPDOWN INTERNALS ── */
.sift-c-dd-cols { display: flex; gap: 0; }
.sift-c-dd-col {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 24px;
  border-right: 0.5px solid #eeecec;
}
.sift-c-dd-col:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.sift-c-dd-col:last-child  { border-right: none; padding-right: 0; }

/* promo column — slightly wider, distinct bg */
.sift-c-dd-col-promo {
  flex: 0 0 260px;
  padding: 0 0 0 24px;
  border-right: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.sift-c-dd-section-label {
  font-size: calc(var(--text-2xs) - 2px);

  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--primary);

}
.sift-c-dd-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;

  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.sift-c-dd-item:hover { background: #EAF0FF; }
.sift-c-dd-icon {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #EAF0FF;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.sift-c-dd-icon .sift-c-ph-svg { width: 20px; color: var(--primary); flex-shrink: 0; }
.sift-c-dd-icon .sift-c-ph-svg img { vertical-align: middle; display: block; }  
.sift-c-dd-icon i { font-size: 20px; color: var(--primary); }
.sift-c-dd-item-callout .sift-c-dd-icon i { color: var(--primary); }
.sift-c-dd-name {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0b0c1e;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.sift-c-dd-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  color: #6b7280;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sift-c-dd-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #044732;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin-left: 5px;
  position: relative;
  top: -1px;
}
.sift-c-dd-divider {
  height: 0.5px;
  background: #eeecec;
  margin: 14px 0 12px;
}

/* ── COMPACT GRID ITEMS (icon + name only, no description) ── */
.sift-c-dd-item-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 2px 20px;
}
.sift-c-dd-item-compact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.12s;
}
.sift-c-dd-item-compact:hover { background: #EAF0FF; }
.sift-c-dd-icon-sm {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: #EAF0FF;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sift-c-dd-icon-sm svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: var(--primary); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.sift-c-dd-name-sm { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600; color: #0b0c1e; white-space: nowrap; }

/* ── PINNED CALLOUT LINK (e.g. "See All Solutions") ── */
.sift-c-dd-item-callout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 11px 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #EAF0FF;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  transition: background 0.12s;
}
.sift-c-dd-item-callout:hover { background: #dde8fd; }
.sift-c-dd-item-callout .sift-c-dd-icon { background: white; margin-top: 0; }
.sift-c-dd-item-callout-text { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 700; color: var(--base); flex: 1; }
.sift-c-dd-item-callout-arrow { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--primary); flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── PROMO CARDS ── */
.sift-c-dd-card {
    border-radius: var(--radius-s);
    padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-s);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}
.sift-c-dd-card:hover { opacity: 0.9; }
.sift-c-dd-card-dark  { background: var(--base); }
.sift-c-dd-card-light { background: #EAF0FF; }
.sift-c-dd-card-mint  { background: var(--accent); }
.sift-c-dd-card-gold  { background: #FFCA36; }
.sift-c-dd-card-pink  { background: #FF3B84; }

.sift-c-dd-card-eyebrow {
  font-size: calc(var(--text-2xs) - 2px);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  line-height: 100%;
}
.sift-c-eyebrow-blue   { color: var(--primary); }
.sift-c-eyebrow-mint   { color: var(--accent); }
.sift-c-eyebrow-pink   { color: #FF3B84; }
.sift-c-eyebrow-navy   { color: var(--base); }
.sift-c-eyebrow-white  { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }
.sift-c-eyebrow-dark   { color: rgba(0,18,77,0.55); }

.sift-c-dd-card-title  { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 700; line-height: 140%; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.sift-c-title-dark  { color: var(--base); }
.sift-c-title-white { color: white; }
.sift-c-title-navy  { color: var(--base); }

.sift-c-dd-card-body   { font-size: var(--text-2xs); line-height: 1.55; margin-bottom: 10px; flex: 1; }
.sift-c-body-dark  { color: #4b5563; }
.sift-c-body-white { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68); }
.sift-c-body-navy  { color: rgba(0,18,77,0.65); }

.sift-c-dd-card-link {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 100%;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: auto;
}
.sift-c-link-blue  { color: var(--primary); }
.sift-c-link-mint  { color: var(--accent); }
.sift-c-link-navy  { color: var(--base); }
.sift-c-link-white { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }
.sift-c-link-arrow { font-size: var(--text-xs); }

/* footer quick-links */
.sift-c-dd-footer {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 0.5px solid #eeecec;
  margin-top: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sift-c-dd-footer-link {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #b8cefd;
  border-radius: 100px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.12s;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.sift-c-dd-footer-link:hover { background: #EAF0FF; }

/* ── CUSTOMER STAT COLUMNS ── */
.sift-c-dd-top-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 0.5px solid #eeecec;
}
.sift-c-dd-top-links .sift-c-dd-item { flex: 1; margin-bottom: 0; }
.sift-c-cust-stats { display: flex; gap: 16px; }
.sift-c-cust-stat-col {
  flex: 1;
  background: #F5F8FF;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  padding: var(--space-s);
  transition: background 0.15s, opacity 0.15s;
}
.sift-c-cust-stat-col:hover { background: #EAF0FF; }
.sift-c-cust-stat-col.sift-c-dark { background: var(--base); }

.sift-c-cust-stat-col.sift-c-light-teal { background: #E9FBF2; }

.sift-c-cust-stat-number {

}
.sift-c-cust-stat-company {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;

}
.sift-c-cust-stat-tagline {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--base);
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.sift-c-cust-stat-col.sift-c-dark .sift-c-cust-stat-tagline { color: white; }
.sift-c-cust-stat-link {
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--base);

  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;

}

.sift-c-cust-stat-col.sift-c-light-pink .sift-c-cust-stat-company { color: #FF3B84; }

/* ── FULL-WIDTH HORIZONTAL PROMO BAND ── */
.sift-c-dd-footer-band {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 0.5px solid #eeecec;
}
.sift-c-dd-card-h {

/* ══════════ ANIMATION PRESET EXTRAS ══════════ */
/* Playful: icons + pills pop in */
@keyframes siftPop { 0%{transform:scale(.35);opacity:0} 68%{transform:scale(1.14)} 100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1} }
body.sift-c-anim-playful .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-icon,
body.sift-c-anim-playful .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-icon-sm,
body.sift-c-anim-playful .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-card-h-icon,
body.sift-c-anim-playful .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-cust-stat-number {
  animation: siftPop .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both;
}
/* Playful: stagger the pops a touch by column position */
body.sift-c-anim-playful .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open .sift-c-dd-col:nth-child(2) .sift-c-dd-icon { animation-delay: .05s; }

/* ══════════ PRESET SWITCHER UI ══════════ */
#anim-switch {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 22px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 5000; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  background: rgba(0,10,40,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 6px 8px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,16,0.4);
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}

.sift-c-nav-hamburger{ display:none; position:relative; background:none; border:none; color:#fff;
  font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; margin-left:auto; padding:6px 4px;
  width:34px; height:34px; }
.sift-c-nav-hamburger-icon{
  position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
  opacity:1;
  transition: transform var(--nav-hover-dur, .18s) ease, opacity var(--nav-hover-dur, .18s) ease;
}
.sift-c-nav-hamburger-icon-close{ transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-90deg) scale(0.5); opacity:0; }
.sift-c-nav-hamburger.sift-c-open .sift-c-nav-hamburger-icon-bars{ transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg) scale(0.5); opacity:0; }

.sift-c-nav-hamburger i {
    display: block;
    width: 30px;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: var(--white);
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: all .4s cubic-bezier(0.25, .1, .25, 1);
}
  
.sift-c-nav-hamburger i::before, .sift-c-nav-hamburger i::after {
    content: "";
    width: 30px;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: var(--white);
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: all .4s cubic-bezier(0.25, .1, .25, 1);
}
  
.sift-c-nav-hamburger i::before {
    top: -8px;
}
  
.sift-c-nav-hamburger i::after {
    top: 8px;
}

  
.sift-c-nav-hamburger.sift-c-open i {
    background-color: transparent;
}
  
.sift-c-nav-hamburger.sift-c-open i::before {
    top: 0;
    transform: rotate(45deg);
}
  
.sift-c-nav-hamburger.sift-c-open i::after {
    top: 0;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}
  
[data-header-style="Standard"] .sift-c-nav-hamburger i {
    background-color: var(--black);
}

    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;

.circular-cta-block .aos-animate circle {
    fill: transparent;
    stroke: #ff3b84;
    stroke-width: 2px;
    stroke-dasharray: 471;
    stroke-dashoffset: 471;
    animation: clock-animation .6s ease-in forwards;
    transform: rotate(-135deg) scale(1.71);
    transform-origin: center;
}

.circular-cta-block .aos-animate .circular-cta-block_line {
    animation: line-animation .4s ease-out .6s forwards;
}

.circular-cta-block_code {
    transform: rotate(-43deg);
}

.circular-cta-block_code .aos-animate .circular-cta-block_btn {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: btn-animation .3s ease-in 1s forwards;
}

@keyframes clock-animation {
    0% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 471
    }

    to {
        stroke-dashoffset: 120
    }
}

@keyframes line-animation {
    0% {
        width: 0
    }

    to {
        width: 96%
    }
}

@keyframes btn-animation {
    0% {
        opacity: 0
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1
    }
}

@media (min-width: 1200px) and (max-height: 950px) {
    .circular-cta-block .aos-animate circle {

<script type='text/javascript'>$(document).ready(function () {
  // Toggle dropdown visibility
  $(".sift_nav_toggle").on("click", function () {
    $(this).toggleClass("active");
    $(".careers-float-nav__block").toggleClass("show");
  });

  // Update .sift_nav_toggle h6 text and close the dropdown on menu item click
  $(".inner-page-menu-items li a").on("click", function () {
    const selectedText = $(this).text(); // Get the text of the clicked link
    $(".sift_nav_toggle p").text(selectedText); // Update the toggle text
    $(".careers-float-nav__block").removeClass("show"); // Hide the dropdown
    $(".sift_nav_toggle").removeClass("active"); // Remove active class
  });

  // Scroll-based section highlighting and toggle text update
  var $links = $(".careers-float-nav__nav-link");
  var sections = $links.map(function () {
    return $($(this).attr("href"));
  });

  function updateActiveClass() {
    var scrollPosition = $(window).scrollTop();
    var viewportHeight = $(window).height();
    var activeSection = null;

    sections.each(function () {
      var $section = $(this);
      var offset = $section.offset();

      if (!offset) return;

      var sectionTop = offset.top;
      var sectionBottom = sectionTop + $section.outerHeight();

      if (
        sectionTop <= scrollPosition + viewportHeight / 2 &&
        sectionBottom > scrollPosition + viewportHeight / 2
      ) {
        activeSection = this;
        return false; // Exit loop
      }
    });

    // Remove and add active class to links
    $links.removeClass("active");
    if (activeSection) {
      var activeLink = $links.filter('[href="#' + $(activeSection).attr("id") + '"]');
      activeLink.addClass("active");

      // Update .sift_nav_toggle h6 text with the active link's text
      $(".sift_nav_toggle p").text(activeLink.text());
    }
  }

  // Run on scroll and on initial loadd
  $(window).on("scroll", updateActiveClass);
  updateActiveClass();
});

      form.insertBefore(wrapper, labelRow);
      wrapper.appendChild(labelRow);
      wrapper.appendChild(dropdownRow);
    }
  }

  const toggle = () => {
    const isOpen = dropdownRow.classList.contains("open");
    labelRow.classList.toggle("active", !isOpen);
    dropdownRow.classList.toggle("open", !isOpen);

  if (!labelRow.__mktoClickAttached) {
    labelRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const tag = e.target.tagName.toLowerCase();
      if (tag === "input" || tag === "label") return; // ignore direct clicks on inputs/labels
      e.stopPropagation();
      toggle();
    });
    labelRow.__mktoClickAttached = true;
  }

  if (!dropdownRow.__mktoStopPropagationAttached) {
    dropdownRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();

  }

    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (!wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
        labelRow.classList.remove("active");

    });
    document.__mktoOutsideClickAttached = true;
  }

  const checkboxList = dropdownRow.querySelector("#mktoForm_2147 .mktoCheckboxList");

      const lbl = checkboxList.querySelector(`label[for='${input.id}']`);

        checkboxList.insertBefore(item, input);
        item.appendChild(input);
        item.appendChild(lbl);
      }
    });

    checkboxList.__mktoCheckboxWrapped = true;
    console.log("Wrapped dropdown checkboxes into .mktoCheckboxItem");
  }

})();

       <script>
var scrolling;
var position = 0;
var delta = 5;
var hh = $('#brx-header').outerHeight();
var dh = $(document).height();
var wh = $(window).height();

$(window).scroll(function(event) {
  scrolling = true;
});

setInterval(function() {
  if (scrolling) {
    scrollFunction();
    scrolling = false;
  }
}, 250);

function scrollFunction() {
  var st = $(this).scrollTop();

  if (Math.abs(position - st) <= delta)
    return;

  if (st > position && st > hh) {
    // Scrolling down
    $('#brx-header').removeClass('scroll-down').addClass('scroll-up');
    $('.header_match').removeClass('hh-scroll-down').addClass('hh-scroll-up');
  } else {
    // Scrolling up
    if (st + wh < dh) {
      $('#brx-header').removeClass('scroll-up').addClass('scroll-down');
      $('.header_match').removeClass('hh-scroll-up').addClass('hh-scroll-down');
    }
    if (st <= 200) {
      $('#brx-header').removeClass('scroll-down');
      $('.header_match').removeClass('hh-scroll-down');
    }
  }
  position = st;
}	
</script>

    // sending ?source=google&medium=cpc). Read them only when the utm_* version
    // is absent, so a real utm_* value always wins.
    var QUERY_PARAM_FALLBACKS = {

        var value = params.get(param) || '';
        if (!value && QUERY_PARAM_FALLBACKS[param]) {

/* ── device-friendly menu: hamburger + accordion + panel relocation ── */
(function(){
  var MQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1155px)');
  var heroWrap = document.querySelector('.sift-c-nav-hero-wrap');
  var navBar   = document.querySelector('.sift-c-nav-bar');
  var navItems = document.querySelector('.sift-c-nav-items');
  var navCta   = document.querySelector('.sift-c-nav-cta');
  var ham      = document.getElementById('navHamburger');

  var scrollLockY = 0;

  function smoothScrollTo(el, targetTop, duration){
    var startTop = el.scrollTop;
    var distance = targetTop - startTop;
    var startTime = null;
    function easeInOutQuad(t){ return t < 0.5 ? 2*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t+2, 2)/2; }
    function step(timestamp){
      if(startTime === null) startTime = timestamp;
      var elapsed = timestamp - startTime;
      var progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      el.scrollTop = startTop + distance * easeInOutQuad(progress);
      if(progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function closeOverlay(){
    heroWrap.classList.remove('sift-c-mm-open');
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('sift-c-mm-open');
    document.body.classList.remove('sift-c-mm-open');
    document.body.style.top = '';
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollLockY);
    if(ham){ ham.classList.remove('sift-c-open'); ham.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }
    document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-item .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('sift-c-open'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-trigger.sift-c-active').forEach(function(t){ t.classList.remove('sift-c-active'); });
  }

  /* menu starts right below notification bar height + nav bar height combined,
     whether or not the notification bar is showing on this page */
  var notifBar = document.getElementById('notifiction-bar');
  function updateNavBottom(){
    if(!heroWrap) return;
    var notifHeight = 0;
    if(notifBar){
      var notifStyle = window.getComputedStyle(notifBar);
      if(notifStyle.display !== 'none' && notifStyle.visibility !== 'hidden'){
        notifHeight = notifBar.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      }
    }
    var navHeight = heroWrap.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sift-nav-bottom', Math.max(notifHeight + navHeight, 0) + 'px');
  }
  function updateNavBottomIfOpen(){
    if(heroWrap.classList.contains('sift-c-mm-open')) updateNavBottom();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(updateNavBottom);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateNavBottomIfOpen);

  /* re-measure whenever the notification bar above the header is closed/hidden,
     since that changes the header's position without a resize or scroll firing */
  if(notifBar){
    new MutationObserver(updateNavBottom).observe(notifBar, {
      attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
    });
  }

  /* move panels + CTA between desktop (siblings) and mobile (nested accordion) */
  function place(){

    document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-item[data-menu]').forEach(function(item){
      var id = item.getAttribute('data-menu');
      var panel = document.getElementById('dd-'+id);
      if(!panel) return;
      if(MQ.matches){
        if(panel.parentElement!==item){
          
          item.appendChild(panel);
        }
      }
      else if(panel.parentElement!==heroWrap){
        
        heroWrap.appendChild(panel);
        panel.classList.remove('sift-c-open');
      }
    });
    if(MQ.matches){ if(navCta && navCta.parentElement!==navItems) navItems.appendChild(navCta); }
    else {
      if(navCta && navCta.parentElement!==navBar) navBar.insertBefore(navCta, ham);
      closeOverlay();
      document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-trigger.sift-c-active').forEach(function(t){t.classList.remove('sift-c-active');});
    }
  }
  place();
  MQ.addEventListener('change', function() {
    place();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    place();
  });
  // A third-party chat widget can shrink window.innerWidth (confirmed via
  // matchMedia().matches flipping to true) without firing a window resize
  // event AND without changing the box size of navBar or body — ruling out
  // both event listeners and ResizeObserver. Nothing in the DOM reliably
  // signals this change, so fall back to polling matchMedia's state directly.
  var lastMQMatches = MQ.matches;
  
  setInterval(function(){
    if (MQ.matches !== lastMQMatches) {
      lastMQMatches = MQ.matches;
      place();
    }
  }, 300);

  if(ham){ ham.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    var open = !heroWrap.classList.contains('sift-c-mm-open');
    if(!open){ closeOverlay(); return; }
    updateNavBottom();
    scrollLockY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0;
    heroWrap.classList.add('sift-c-mm-open');
    document.documentElement.classList.add('sift-c-mm-open');
    document.body.classList.add('sift-c-mm-open');
    document.body.style.top = (-scrollLockY) + 'px';
    ham.classList.add('sift-c-open');
    ham.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  });}

  /* accordion: on mobile, tapping a trigger toggles its own panel */
  document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-item[data-menu]').forEach(function(item){
    var trg = item.querySelector('.sift-c-nav-trigger');
    var id  = item.getAttribute('data-menu');
    if(!trg) return;
    trg.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      // Read innerWidth fresh at click time instead of trusting the MQ object —
      // MQ.matches was observed flickering true/false rapidly while a
      // third-party widget's layout settled, and a click can land in a
      // momentary false window even though the mobile layout is correctly
      // showing on screen.
      var isMobileNow = window.innerWidth <= 1155;
      if(!isMobileNow) { console.log('[sift-nav] click ignored — not mobile width'); return; }
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      var panel = document.getElementById('dd-'+id);
      console.log('[sift-nav] panel found:', panel, '| panel.parentElement:', panel ? panel.parentElement : null, '| is item the parent?', panel ? panel.parentElement === item : null);
      if(panel && panel.parentElement !== item){
        console.log('[sift-nav] panel was not relocated yet — moving it now before toggling open');
        item.appendChild(panel);
      }
      var willOpen = !panel.classList.contains('sift-c-open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-item .sift-c-nav-dropdown-wrapper.sift-c-open').forEach(function(p){ if(p!==panel) p.classList.remove('sift-c-open'); });
      document.querySelectorAll('.sift-c-nav-trigger.sift-c-active').forEach(function(t){ if(t!==trg) t.classList.remove('sift-c-active'); });
      panel.classList.toggle('sift-c-open', willOpen);
      trg.classList.toggle('sift-c-active', willOpen);

      if(willOpen){
        // bring the opened dropdown's trigger (parent nav item) to the top of
        // the overlay's own scroll container only — never the page/body.
        // Wait for any other panel's collapse transition to finish first,
        // otherwise its still-animating height throws off the measurement.
        setTimeout(function(){
          var containerTop = navItems.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          var itemTop = item.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          var targetScrollTop = navItems.scrollTop + (itemTop - containerTop);
          smoothScrollTo(navItems, targetScrollTop, 500);
        }, 470);
      }
    });
  });
})();

(function () {
  "use strict";

  function scrollToTarget(target) {
    var stableCount = 0;
    var lastY = -1;
    var attempts = 0;
    var maxAttempts = 90;

    function check() {
      var rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      var y = Math.round(rect.top + window.pageYOffset);

      if (y === lastY) {
        stableCount++;
      } else {
        stableCount = 0;
        lastY = y;
      }
      attempts++;

      if (stableCount >= 5 || attempts >= maxAttempts) {
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
        return;
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(check);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(check);
  }

  function handleInitialHash() {
    if (!window.location.hash) return;
    var target = document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.slice(1)));
    if (target) scrollToTarget(target);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "complete") {
    handleInitialHash();
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("load", handleInitialHash);
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var link = e.target.closest('a[href*="#"]');
    if (!link) return;

    var url = new URL(link.href, window.location.origin);
    if (url.pathname === window.location.pathname && url.hash) {
      var target = document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(url.hash.slice(1)));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        scrollToTarget(target);
        history.pushState(null, "", url.hash);
      }
    }
  });
})();
